propositions: Prevent a ticket from closing if its own plan or pinned upstream plan changed during execution without re-running plan review or invalidating all implementations.

Add a configurable close-time plan-review gate that verifies signature, material currency, phase compatibility, and pin health but exempts code freshness checks since implementation files are expected to drift.
Execute the plan-review gate inside the existing transaction lock as a pre-status-check callback immediately before appending the STATUS event to catch changes between precheck and commit.
Return exact validity verdicts (unsigned, stale-reopened, stale-regver, stale-material, etc.) and fail-closed on exceptions; never invoke LLM, network, or model calls.
Preserve all existing exemptions (bugs, session logs, code reviews, identities, idea→closed) and force-close bypass behavior; default the flag to false for byte-for-byte equivalence when disabled.
